claimed_advantages.summary: Submission claims smaller keys and ciphertexts from p=2 and an average-case-failure-friendly transform.
claimed_advantages.comparison_scope: Compared in Table 5 with selected NTRU+ and ML-KEM parameter sets

claimed_advantages.summary: AVX2 implementation is claimed to reduce operation cycle counts by about 1.3x to 2.7x.
claimed_advantages.comparison_scope: Reference C versus submitted AVX2 implementation on the stated Intel platform

claimed_advantages.summary: FOAC' retains re-encryption checking and is claimed IND-CCA2 secure in ROM and QROM from the underlying assumptions.
Parameter design is claimed tunable across security levels while balancing communication and computation.

limitations_and_constraints.summary: Valid-ciphertext decapsulation has nonzero, parameter-dependent failure probability (2^-549, 2^-370, 2^-298).
Reported benchmarks use one core of an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX under WSL 2 Ubuntu 26.04 with GCC 15.2.0; generalization to other platforms is untested in the cited table.

Submission states ICCS symmetric-primitive APIs are slower than mainstream primitives such as SHA-3, so cycle counts mainly measure submitted optimization speedup rather than absolute scheme performance.
Optimized implementation depends on AVX2, AVX-VNNI, FMA3 and SHA instruction support for stated acceleration.

implementations.name: Reference_Implementation
implementations.platform: portable C / submitted x86 test environment

evidence.summary: Basic information form names the KEM and lists ten submitters, affiliations, and contact role.
Specification defines the NTRU/RLWE assumptions, NTRE.CPAPKE, FOAC' conversion, IND-CCA2 model, ROM and QROM reductions.
Ring, CBD psi_1, NTT representation and symmetric primitive instantiations are specified.
Formal names, n, q, failure probabilities, security estimates and byte sizes are tabulated.
Implementation defines the shared-secret size as 64 bytes for each parameter set.
Performance analysis, comparison scope, implementation features, caveats and stated key features.

review_notes: NTRE baseline manually checked against basic-information form, specification tables and all three reference params.h files.
D=3/4 is recorded only as an unresolved implementation parameter; no semantic interpretation was inferred.

issues.message: NTRE_D values 3/4 lack an explicit semantic definition in reviewed material.
No explicit algorithm version string was located in prioritized material.
